name: After an upgrade: health check
description: Five minutes after AgentMux starts on a new version, it checks that this computer's agents are running, that cloud messages reach it and that the other computers on the LAN answer. All well: one line to the leader. Something not up: a Kanban task for the steward that names what, and a notification. A restart that is no upgrade starts nothing.

leader.title: Who to tell
leader.description: The id of the agent that gets the one-line all-clear as a message.

steward.title: Who gets the task
steward.description: The id of the agent that gets a Kanban task when something is not up after an upgrade.
